chunks: Whatever is in it from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz, from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; an immediate link in the author’s transmission chain.
key_terms.الْخَزَّازِ: An identifying epithet for Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā within the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler through the cited sanad/isnad.
key_terms.غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: A transmitter from whom the reports in this chain are narrated.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving hadith provenance within Shia hadith scholarship.
